review_note: Delhaye et al. 2018 explicitly calls C. longifolia self-compatible and cites Owens 1981 plus Faden 2012. Owens 1981 is a primary 110-species SI survey, but the accessible abstract does not expose the species table. Do not use as the third Cyanotis genus-rule vote until the original species row is inspected.

The 2021 field study states that bee visits contribute to selfing within/between flowers of the same plant and movement among different plants, but provides no paternity or controlled hand-self/cross test. Keep as a lead, not a strict mating-system record.

A Nepalese Lindernia revision reports that Khan & Hassan 1973 conducted pollination experiments and concluded cross-pollination was remote and capsules formed through self-pollination in L. pusilla and five congeners. POWO now accepts the Asian L. pusilla as Yamazakia pusilla, while both frozen Lindernia pusilla and Yamazakia pusilla occur in the project universe. Resolve identity duplication and inspect the primary article before coverage promotion.
